terms.terms:
CorpFlowAI Ltd — commercial terms (standard ERPNext Terms and Conditions)

These terms apply to quotations and invoices issued from ERPNext. They do not replace a signed contract where one exists.

  1. Validity. This quotation is valid for 14 days from the quotation date unless a different Valid Till date is shown on the document.
  2. Scope. Scope is limited to the Item names and descriptions on this document. Anything not listed is excluded.
  3. Assumptions. The client provides timely access, content, brand assets, and decision-makers. Delay in access pauses the delivery clock.
  4. Exclusions. No SEO ranking, lead-volume, conversion, or revenue guarantees. Third-party hosting, domain, advertising, and software-licence fees are excluded unless a line item says otherwise. Recurring CorpFlowAI fees apply only when a recurring Item is listed.
  5. Payment — MUR project work. 50% deposit by manual bank transfer before work starts; balance before production release or on delivery acceptance, as stated on the document. Proof-of-payment alone is not bank clearance.
  6. Payment — USD Lead Rescue launch pilot. Setup is payable before the 48-hour setup window starts. Monthly monitoring, if listed, is invoiced in advance, month-to-month, with no auto-debit in this phase.
  7. Approval to build. ERPNext documents are commercial records. The fail-closed financial approval-to-build gate remains the CorpFlowAI commercial rail (#714 / #766): quotation + written acceptance + payment evidence (or approved exception) + named financial approver. ERPNext does not auto-approve a build.
  8. Contact. Commercial documents: finance@corpflowai.com.

Synthetic / test documents carry a TEST-ONLY remark and must not be sent to a paying client.
